headline: Four new faces to join the cabinet this Friday night
summary: The BNP-led government is expanding its cabinet with four new members, following the swearing-in of President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.
details: The BNP-led government, under the leadership of Tarique Rahman, is undergoing a cabinet reshuffle and expansion today, Friday, August 21, as it completes six months in power.

Four new members are expected to join the cabinet. These include BNP senior leader Dr. Abdul Moin Khan, BJP Chairman Barrister Andalib Rahman Partha, BJP member Saching Pru Jerry of Bandaran, and MP Mohammad Shamim Kaiser Lincoln of Gaibandha-4.
The reshuffle comes immediately after the swearing-in ceremony of the newly elected President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir at Bangabhaban at 7 PM tonight.
Due to Mirza Fakhrul's transition to the presidency, his previous portfolio of Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives will be redistributed.
The Prime Minister is also considering changes to the ministers and state ministers in several other ministries to optimize government performance.
caption:
Four new ministers are set to be sworn in tonight at Bangabhaban.

The BNP-led government, under the leadership of Tarique Rahman, is undergoing a cabinet reshuffle and expansion today, Friday, August 21, as it completes six months in power.

Four new members are expected to join the cabinet. These include BNP senior leader Dr. Abdul Moin Khan, BJP Chairman Barrister Andalib Rahman Partha, BJP member Saching Pru Jerry of Bandaran, and MP Mohammad Shamim Kaiser Lincoln of Gaibandha-4.

The reshuffle comes immediately after the swearing-in ceremony of the newly elected President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir at Bangabhaban at 7 PM tonight.

Due to Mirza Fakhrul's transition to the presidency, his previous portfolio of Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives will be redistributed.

The Prime Minister is also considering changes to the ministers and state ministers in several other ministries to optimize government performance.

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Somoy News

headline_marked: President-elect Mirza Fakhrul [[pays homage to Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia]] before oath
headline: President-elect Mirza Fakhrul pays homage to Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia before oath
summary: The 23rd President of Bangladesh, Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, visited the graves of the BNP founder and former PM before his swearing-in ceremony.
details: President-elect Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir paid his respects at the graves of BNP founder and former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia.
Mirza Fakhrul was elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh on Thursday, receiving 255 votes in a direct election.
The visit to the graves occurred before his official swearing-in ceremony, which is scheduled for Friday evening at Bangabhaban.
The President-elect, who previously served as the Secretary General of the BNP, described Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia as his political companions and mentors.
caption:
Before taking the oath of office, President-elect Mirza Fakhrul visited the graves of his political mentors.

President-elect Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir paid his respects at the graves of BNP founder and former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia.

Mirza Fakhrul was elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh on Thursday, receiving 255 votes in a direct election.

The visit to the graves occurred before his official swearing-in ceremony, which is scheduled for Friday evening at Bangabhaban.

The President-elect, who previously served as the Secretary General of the BNP, described Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia as his political companions and mentors.

#Bangladesh #Politics #MirzaFakhrul #BNP #Bangabhaban

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Somoy News, The Daily Star
